acceptance: Core exports the detector contract (roots, drive/UNC rules, placeholder allowlist, accepted and rejected example cases) in the site-inputs bundle, generated from the shared detector in benchbox/validation/bundle.py.
The site gate test consumes that contract (bundle:fetch) and fails on drift; the hand-copied case tables are removed.
A core test fails when the contract changes without the bundle regenerating.
context:
Cross-repo: the core change must publish before the site change can consume it (see benchbox-site bundle:fetch flow). Verification rubric: reproduce drift (change an allowlist entry, show nothing fails today); fix; tests in both repos; comment-policy and ruff; PRs merged with green CI.

BATCH DECISIONS (2026-11-09): this batch delivers the CORE half only: generate the detector contract (roots, drive/UNC rules, placeholder allowlist, accepted/rejected example cases) from the shared detector in benchbox/validation/bundle.py into the site-inputs bundle (see scripts/site_inputs.py, make/site-inputs.mk, quality/doc-contracts.schema.json and docs/internal/doc-contracts.md for the established contract shape; decide by evidence whether it extends doc-contracts.json or is a new sidecar, and update the schema/tests accordingly) plus a core test that fails when the contract and detector disagree. The bundle is published automatically by .github/workflows/site-inputs.yml after merge to develop. The SITE half (consume the contract in the deploy gate test, remove hand-copied case tables in benchbox-site) is done by the controller in a separate site PR after core merges; do not touch benchbox-site. Must land AFTER the residual-limits item if both change the detector contract (the contract should describe the final detector). GUARDRAILS: stored fingerprints are never recomputed; never print leaked path values in diagnostics; do not widen the detector to every absolute path (owner decision 2026-11-08); fail-closed publish behavior stays; private non-anonymized exports unchanged; no hosted data deletion or history rewrite. Verification rubric: (1) reproduce with a failing test or script before editing; (2) focused suites pass via uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff on touched files; (4) the runtime smoke named in acceptance is recorded in the PR body; (5) one final batch PR merges with green CI and a passing oracle review.
description: The site deploy gate (benchbox-site PR #128) uses a hand-ported TypeScript copy of core's local-path detector (known roots, drive letters, UNC, placeholder allowlist). The core site-inputs bundle publishes no path-privacy contract, so nothing mechanically detects drift between the two; the site README only asks maintainers to keep them in step. A core change to the roots or allowlist could silently desynchronize the site gate.
